text:
Sasha: Quick sync — perf team needs a canonical benchmark for the regression work. Proposal: replay harness (sampled prod traces) + synthetic generator with tail distributions. We also need apples-to-apples compare tooling. Key ask: clear metric defs (TTFT, TPOT), batch/KV/kernel telemetry, and unified reporting for p95/p99 and goodput vs QPS. Anyone object?
Marta: can you spell out TTFT vs TPOT in one line? i've seen different defs across docs.
Sasha: sure — TTFT = time from request accepted by runtime to first token emitted (ms). TPOT = time per output token (avg ms/token) measured after first token, or tokens/sec inverted for throughput view. We should report both.
Raj: note KV cache warm/cold will blow up TTFT. if you measure cold-cache requests only you'll get very different p95. we should include both cold and warm profiles.
Kevin: FYI we observed a perf regression last week after a kernel-selection change: p95 TTFT for seq512 jumped ~15% on a8x. looks like the int8 fallback path was chosen for certain layer shapes.
Anya: to reproduce we need: a) replay trace sampling that preserves prompt lengths & tokenization b) ability to prefill KV cache (i.e., mark requests as cache-warm) c) exact model + quantization pinned. also keep same HW/driver.
perf-bot: perf-ci reported: baseline p95_ttft=118ms -> current p95_ttft=136ms (+15%). cpu/gpu util diff: +6% GPU util.
Dan: add metrics: goodput = delivered output tokens / wall time (tokens/sec). QPS = requests started / sec. Goodput measures useful work; QPS can be gamed by tiny responses. report both and token-length-weighted QPS.
Marta: batching heuristics — do we test static_max_batch vs dynamic batching with queue timeout? want to see tradeoffs at 50, 100, 200 ms SLOs.
Raj: here's a minimal batch config we use in harness: ```
max_batch_size: 64
queue_timeout_ms: 50  # dynamic batching threshold
min_batch_size: 1
priority: latency
```
use this plus a static run with fixed batch sizes (1,8,32,64).
Kevin: also capture kernel_selection per request in logs: kernel_id + reason (shape, quantization, fallback). then we can correlate kernel -> p95.
Anya: for synthetic generator include distribution knobs: prompt_len_dist (long tail), output_len_mean, concurrency_profile (poisson vs burst). replay should sample actual inter-arrival times and preserve user session prefixes for KV cache hits.
Sasha: agreed. For apples-to-apples: pin model+weights+quant config, same OS/driver/cuda/cudnn, same tokenization seed, and run on same instance type. Put all config into a single yml that the compare script consumes.
Kevin: to validate kernel regression: run harness with kernel pinned to old kernel and new kernel; if pinned-old matches baseline, we know auto-selection caused regression.
Dan: add TPOT breakdown: pre-tokenization, model forward per token, post-processing. TPOT = model_forward_time / tokens_emitted (plus small infra overhead).
Marta: how to report percentiles: we should report median, p95, p99 for TTFT and TPOT, plus error bars across 3 runs. capture per-run GPU utilization and GC/host CPU spikes.
Raj: telemetry: include per-request fields: request_id, start_ts, first_token_ts, last_token_ts, tokens_emitted, kernel_id, kv_cache_hit(Boolean). dump as newline JSON for the whole run so compare script can aggregate.
perf-bot: note — CI storage for large runs is limited. recommend storing aggregated CSV + sampled raw traces (1% of requests).
Anya: I'll update the replay harness to: - accept sampled prod traces - support prefill mode for KV - output per-request telemetry described by Raj - add a "pin-kernel" flag.
Sasha: perfect. can you also add a synthetic config with the long-tail prompt_len and bursty arrival generator? add default configs for: "latency-focused", "throughput-focused", "mixed-prod-like".
Anya: yes. will land a PR and attach exact config files.
Kevin: i'll run the pinned-kernel experiments once PR lands and post results. also want to try dynamic-batch tuning: increase queue_timeout to 100ms for high-throughput run and compare goodput.
Sasha: action items: Anya -> PR for harness + configs; Kevin -> kernel-pin experiments & perf logs; Marta -> doc section on metric defs & reporting; Raj -> small instrument lib for per-request telemetry. I'll open a tracking ticket. thanks team :thumbsup:
Marta: thanks — i'll draft the doc with the metric table and sample graphs (TTFT vs p95/p99, TPOT CDF, goodput vs concurrency).
Sasha: great, closing sync. if anyone finds a quick repro please drop it here.
